Title: Public preview: Functions upgrade in Azure Monitor log analytics

Body.Content:
A function is a log query in Azure Monitor that can be used in other log queries as though it's a command. Functions allow developers to provide solutions to different customers and for you to reuse query logic in your own environment.

We have enhanced functions with the following:

  • A new functions experience, integrated with log analytics side bar, allowing for easier discovery and usage of functions.
  • Solution functions (pre-built Azure Monitor functions) that are used in solutions and insights.
  • Workspace functions now support parameters, enabling you to create your own functions with parameters to drive faster insights in log analytics.

Learn more.

Read the blog.
